observedScenario.scope: Full synthetic browser journey, including preset iteration and editor activity; not a single page or concurrency benchmark

reader.storeRead: React request-scoped cache by subdomain and anyStatus
reader.navigationRead: Each bundle call starts main/footer/policies HTTP reads; no explicit React request-scoped cache on bundle
reader.transportCaveat: Actual Next fetch deduplication and storefrontReadInit policy must be measured before treating each call as unique database work

nextAcceptance: Inspect storefrontReadInit and API transport cache behavior on the production-built runtime.
Measure cold and repeat homepage/PDP useful content under the same owned fixture: navigation calls by location, store calls, timing and failures.
If duplicate navigation demand is observed within a React request, reuse only request-scoped public results, keyed by exact subdomain; do not add long-lived private or publication state caches.
Verify a second tenant cannot reuse the first tenant navigation and a subsequent request observes an edit under the established freshness contract.
Compare equivalent before/after runs; preserve raw counts and timings without claiming full platform capacity.

transportObservation.observed: storefrontApiFetch generates a new X-Request-ID for every call, including public navigation reads using next.revalidate=60
transportObservation.inference: Per-call random headers may prevent otherwise identical fetch memoization/data-cache reuse. Verify actual installed Next production behavior before changing trace propagation or making quantitative claims.
